source: Owner message on 2026-11-27 to the Claude session doing the UDA and Mission Control work, quoting the end of a reply from another lane.
owner_statement: why am i getting two github handoff lines with every turn?
problem: The rule of 2026-11-08 prescribed a resume line and then a GH handoff line at the end of every final answer, and told a session that couldn't write a local handoff note to name the Git checkpoint in the resume line instead. The GH handoff line names that checkpoint too. The owner reported replies that ended with two lines linking the same file, and quoted one from a lane whose handoff lives in GitHub.
required_behavior: When the resume line links the GitHub checkpoint, it is the GH handoff line: one line, starting 'GH handoff:', that reads as the resume instruction and keeps the explicit 'Next: <one specific safe action>', with any first step there and what it needs reachable from the checkpoint; finished work ends with one 'Closed:' line instead.
A separate resume line comes just before the GH handoff line only when it names a local handoff note updated that turn, such as one on the owner's computer; a reply never ends with two GitHub links.
A reply never ends with two lines that link the same file.
Finished work ends with one Closed line linking the final verified artifact, with no resume line; a link that can't be verified that turn gives the link-free line instead.
scope: The last-lines line in root AGENTS.md; rule 5 and the reference implementation of patterns/cross-account-continuity.md; rule 2 and the verification of patterns/owner-requested-terminal-github-handoff.md; their LESSON-INDEX.md entries; the docs/INDEX.md route; this record; tests.

origin.owner_outcome: Each reply ends with one GitHub handoff line, not two that say the same thing.
origin.notes: Keeping two lines where they point to different places (a local note and a GitHub copy), and the combined line's wording, are the assistant's specification of the owner's words.

execution_surfaces.surface: Root AGENTS.md and the two patterns, read by every session that loads UDA
Lanes whose handoff lives in GitHub
execution_surfaces.reason: Each lane applies the rule at its next final answer after it re-fetches root AGENTS.md. A lane handoff that only repeats the superseded two-line default follows the current rule; a current owner or project requirement still wins on genuine conflict.

nonclaims: A static test proves the rule's text and routing, not what each reply ends with; that stays a per-turn check (WORKFLOW_ONLY).
This change does not edit any lane's own handoff file.

supersedes_in_part.part: its two-line ending and its instruction to name the Git checkpoint in the resume line: the two-line ending survives only for open work whose resume line names a local note updated that turn; everywhere else one line ends the reply: no two links to the same file, no two distinct GitHub links, and no resume line on finished work
